pipelinq-product-master.description: shillinq → pipelinq cross-app contract. Resolves productId → product definition (name/SKU/category/pricing/attributes) and contactsUid → pipelinq Supplier commercial profile via the ADR-019 integration registry. When pipelinq is unavailable, shillinq renders local denormalised caches (productId + unitCost) and flags them stale. Stock-keeping and GL posting MUST NOT block on a remote lookup.

getProduct.description: Resolve pipelinq productId → Product definition (name, SKU, category, unitPrice, currency, attributes). Returns cached local data when pipelinq is unreachable.

resolveSupplier.description: Resolve NC addressbook contactsUid → pipelinq Supplier commercial profile. Returns null when pipelinq is unreachable; shillinq VendorFinancialProfile serves financial fields independently.

ingestExport.description: pipelinq ingest reads shillinq's export payload from app-config key shillinq_pvm_export (JSON). Written by MigrateProductVendorMasterToPipelinq repair step. Format: {products: [...], productAttributes: [...], vendorMasterData: [...]}.
